name: Berserker ring (i)
description: +4% melee strength bonus, on top of the flat strength stat shown — the imbued version's bonus is easy to miss since it isn't broken out separately in the stats interface.

name: Brimstone ring
description: 50% chance to boost Magic accuracy and lower the target's Magic defence on a hit, alongside its listed stat bonuses.

name: Ultor ring
description: +8% melee damage passively; further boosted at low HP, similar in spirit to Dharok's set effect but always active.

name: Magus ring
description: +5% Magic damage passively (12.5% when a staff normally granting Magic damage is wielded), not shown anywhere in the equipment stats panel.

name: Phoenix necklace
description: At or below 20% HP, restores 30% of your max hitpoints and clears all queued damage from future hits before the heal triggers.

name: Salve amulet
description: +16.67% melee accuracy and damage against undead targets, matching the common 1/6 strength bonus used by the item's tooltip and wiki references.

name: Amulet of the Damned
description: Adds Barrows-set effects when worn with a full Barrows set: Dharok's — 25% chance to recoil 15% of damage taken; this can stack with Vengeance and recoil effects. Verac's — +7 Prayer bonus on top of the amulet's +3. Torag's — Defence is increased by 1% for every missing Hitpoint, stacking with temporary boosts. Guthan's — heals up to 10 Hitpoints above your base Hitpoints level. Karil's — 25% chance to hit twice with one attack; the second hit deals half the damage of the first. Ahrim's — Ahrim's staff auto-casts Ancient Magicks and gives a 25% chance for combat spells to deal 30% more damage.

name: Amulet of avarice
description: Same base bonuses as an amulet of glory, plus a hidden +20% accuracy and damage bonus against Revenants and roughly doubled unique drop rates while skulled in the Revenant Caves, Wilderness Slayer Cave, and Chaos Temple - none of it shown on the stats screen.

name: Amulet of blood fury
description: On a successful melee hit, carries an unlisted 20% chance to heal the wielder 30% of the damage dealt, consuming one of its charges per hit regardless of whether it procs.

name: Ring of the gods (i)
description: The imbued version silently grants the passive effect of a holy wrench (restores extra Prayer points per dose of Prayer potion) on top of its +8 Prayer bonus - the wrench effect itself isn't shown on the stats screen.

name: Ring of recoil
description: Reflects floor(10% of damage taken) + 1 back at the attacker, consuming one of 40 charges per proc - the exact formula isn't stated in-game, only a remaining charge count.

name: Ring of wealth (imbued)
description: While in the Wilderness, silently doubles the chance of receiving a clue scroll from both monster drops and skilling, with no in-game indication of the multiplier.

name: Lightbearer
description: Doubles special attack energy regeneration rate (10% every 15 seconds instead of the standard 30 seconds) - this exact number appears nowhere in the item's stats.

name: Salve amulet (e)
description: Boosts the base Salve amulet's undead bonus from 16.67% to 20% melee Attack and Strength. Does not stack with a black mask/Slayer helmet but does stack with Void Knight equipment.

name: Salve amulet(i)
description: Nightmare Zone/Soul Wars imbue of the base Salve amulet: keeps the 16.67% melee accuracy/damage bonus against undead and extends it to 16.67% Ranged and 15% Magic accuracy/damage. Does not stack with a black mask/Slayer helmet but does stack with Void Knight equipment.

name: Salve amulet (ei)
description: Extends the Salve amulet (e)'s 20% bonus to also grant 20% accuracy and damage in Ranged and Magic against undead monsters.

name: Efaritay's aid
description: Grants a hidden +10% damage and +15% accuracy bonus against vampyric creatures, stacking with a black mask (i)/Slayer helmet (i). Against tier-2 vampyres it also lets non-silver weapons deal half damage. Charge-based (200 charges, one consumed per successful hit).

name: Berserker necklace
description: +20% melee damage while wielding an obsidian weapon (e.g. Toktz-xil-ak), stacking with the Obsidian armour set's own bonus, at the cost of an unlisted -10 attack and -20 defence bonus in every combat style - the trade-off isn't shown together anywhere on the stats screen.

name: Bracelet of ethereum
description: While charged with revenant ether, reduces damage taken from revenants by 75% (consuming 1 charge per attack received) and makes revenants passive toward the wearer - carries zero displayed combat bonuses on the equipment stats screen despite the mechanic.

name: Ring of suffering / Ring of suffering (i)
description: Functions as a built-in, rechargeable ring of recoil: reflects floor(10% of damage taken) + 1 back at the attacker, toggleable, and rechargeable with noted/unnoted rings of recoil (each giving 40 charges, up to 100,000 stored) - identical for both versions. Imbuing only doubles the ring's displayed defensive/prayer bonuses, not the hidden recoil formula itself, contrary to what many players assume.
